newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Oce boosts sales, market share.
newsitem.headline: Oce boosts sales, market share.

text.p: Printer and copier maker Oce-van der Grinten said Monday it had significantly increased sales in all its markets and boosted market share in at least two of the three segments in which it is active.
Sales in the engineering systems market (copying, printing and plotting) increased 15 percent, chairman Harry Pennings told a results news conference.
"Oce has been able to further bolster its leading position in this market which grows structurally by some two to four percent a year," Pennings said.
Turnover in the office systems market rose 17 percent. "This growth clearly outstripped overall market growth...estimated at one or two percent a year worldwide," Pennings said.
Excluding acquisitions, sales of printing systems rose 44 percent to 163 million guilders in a fast-growing market, he said.
SNI Printing -- acquired last year from Siemens Nixdorf of Germany -- posted sales of 730 million guilders over the eight months to December 1, 1996, Pennings added.
